GOAL (design review Step 2, 'typed attempt bundle', hosted path): record one immutable, versioned, typed bundle per turn ATTEMPT, including rejected attempts, so a run can be replayed and classified. Today only the last narration prompt is exposed (provider.last_prompt via web_demo FREYTAG_EXPOSE_PROMPT=1) and a rejected turn leaves nothing. Also today the blind-player labels a late earned scene exit as 'timer' because it compares the transition turn to handoff_after_turns; the bundle must carry the true transition cause instead.

READ FIRST: storygame/runtime/engine.py (RuntimeEngine.turn, _prepare_handoff, _handoff_transition, _apply_authored_transition, _apply_resolution_deadline_backstop, _apply_canonical_route_events, resolve_break), storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py (last_prompt ~line 1751, last_semantic_match ~252-434), storygame/runtime/capture.py (~line 87, second model stage), storygame/web_demo.py (turn route ~325, _turn_payload), tests/test_design_review_fixtures.py and tests/test_narration_corpus.py (how to build real engine state with stubbed providers; no network).

BUILD:
1. storygame/runtime/attempt_bundle.py: frozen pydantic models (match the repo's existing model style, extra='forbid'). AttemptBundle with schema_version: int = 1 and fields: identity (code sha from the same source web_demo's _deployment_sha uses or None, package id/version/content hash if the package exposes one else None, relevant config such as semantic fallback on/off and projection cap), pre_state (scene_id, turn_index, turns_since_scene_entry, staged_cue_fact_id, staged_handoff_fact_ids, delivered_cue_ids, sorted fact predicates), command (raw player input text and normalized command), stages: ordered list of ModelStage(kind: 'narration'|'semantic_match'|'capture', request: system/user prompt text or None, reply: raw reply text or parsed dict or None, error: str|None), selected_reveal (knowledge ids / delivery fact ids chosen by the resolver, or none), committed_delta (fact predicates added/changed, scene change from->to, or empty if not committed), cue_stage (cue fact id staged this turn and whether it was delivered/consumed), transition_cause: Literal['none','earned','forced','timer'], outcome: Literal['committed','rejected','game_break','operational_failure'], rejection (error code and message for ProposalValidationError / RuntimeContractError, else None), operational_failure (provider/NarrationProviderError code, kept APART from rejection so a gameplay miss is never confused with an outage). Provide to_json()/from_json() round-trip helpers and a validator that refuses unknown schema_version.
2. Engine: RuntimeEngine gets `attempts: list[AttemptBundle]` (bounded, e.g. last 24) and `last_attempt`. Build the bundle inside turn() for EVERY path: committed, rejected (ProposalValidationError / RuntimeContractError: record then re-raise unchanged), game_break, and provider failure (NarrationProviderError: record as operational_failure then re-raise unchanged). Collect stages from the provider's last_prompt / last_semantic_match / capture if those attributes exist (use getattr, the provider may be a stub). Do not change any gameplay behaviour: bundle recording must be pure observation and must not alter state, ordering, or exceptions.
3. transition_cause rules (implement by observing what actually caused the scene change this turn, not by comparing turn counts): 'forced' = the scene changed through the staged handoff path (_prepare_handoff delivered authored handoff text because staged_handoff_fact_ids was non-empty and the provider did not select the reveal); 'timer' = the scene changed only because the pacing clock / resolution deadline backstop / timed route event fired without a player-earned reveal; 'earned' = the scene changed because the player's action earned the reveal/route (including when it happens after handoff_after_turns has passed, i.e. the case the blind-player mislabels today); 'none' = no scene change. Read the engine to decide the exact observable for each; document it in a docstring and in notes.md.
4. web_demo.py: when FREYTAG_EXPOSE_PROMPT=1 (the same gate as the prompt) add `attempt_bundle` (bundle JSON) to the successful /api/v1/turn payload (and the game-break payload). For rejected/failed attempts the response is currently an HTTPException with a string `detail` and an X-Freytag-Rejection-Code header: keep detail and headers byte-identical, and when the gate is on, also return the bundle in the JSON body under `attempt_bundle` (use a JSONResponse for that gated case only; ungated behaviour must not change). Keep the existing `prompt` field working unchanged. The bundle must never be exposed when the gate is off.
5. Tests, tests/test_attempt_bundle.py, hermetic (no network, no env vars needed), under 15 s: (a) schema round-trip and unknown-version refusal; (b) REPLAY GATE: drive the real engine with stubbed providers through one accepted turn, one rejected turn (a narration the narration validator rejects, e.g. a premature secret as in tests/test_design_review_fixtures.py), and one forced-handoff continuation (a scene staying unresolved until handoff_after_turns so the staged handoff delivers and the scene changes); assert each bundle's outcome, rejection code, stages kept, selected_reveal, committed_delta and transition_cause ('none'/'none' with rejection/'forced'); (c) an EARNED late exit: a scene change after handoff_after_turns by the player's own earned action must be 'earned' not 'timer'/'forced' (if you cannot build this with real package data say exactly why in notes.md and cover it with the closest real case); (d) operational failure recorded apart from rejection; (e) recording changes no state: the same scripted run with and without reading the bundle yields identical state snapshots, and a rejected turn still restores the pre-turn snapshot; (f) a web_demo test with the gate on: the 409 body carries attempt_bundle while detail and the X-Freytag-Rejection-Code header are unchanged, and with the gate off no attempt_bundle key appears anywhere.
6. Hard rules: no story/genre-specific branches (Forbidden Patterns: the runtime is story-agnostic), no network, no prose-as-truth, do not log secrets or API keys into the bundle (only prompt/reply text and ids). Any new comments/docstrings plain. Code style matches surrounding code.

HOW TO RUN: confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside the cwd. Tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_attempt_bundle.py, then the full suite with -n auto. Ruff: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix . and -m ruff format . . Reply with the files changed.
